# Oral Surgeon in Santa Monica, CA


Home › Areas We Serve › Oral Surgeon in Santa Monica, CA

Santa Monica is one of the most vibrant communities on the Westside of Los Angeles, drawing residents and visitors from across the region to its beaches, parks, and health-conscious lifestyle. For Santa Monica residents who need oral surgery — whether for wisdom tooth removal, dental implants, bone grafting, or more complex reconstructive care — Wilshire Oral Surgery and Implant Center is located just minutes east along Wilshire Boulevard at 12300 Wilshire Blvd #326, Los Angeles, CA 90025. From Santa Monica, the drive east on Wilshire is direct and straightforward, making our office one of the most accessible oral surgery practices for this community.

Our practice is led by two fellowship-trained, board-certified oral and maxillofacial surgeons who bring hospital-level surgical training to an outpatient setting. You can learn more about our team and the credentials that set our surgeons apart from general dental providers.

Dr. Jonathan R. Shadi, DDS

B.S. Neuroscience, UCLA · DDS, USC School of Dentistry · Dean’s List · John Ingle Research Award (2009) · OMFS Internship, Veterans’ Affairs Hospital

Dr. Saman Vahedi, DDS

B.S. Molecular Biology, UCLA · DDS, Herman Ostrow School of Dentistry USC · OMFS Residency, University of Nebraska Medical Center · Chief Resident 2013–2014 · Diplomate, American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons


## Oral Surgery Procedures We Offer Santa Monica Patients


We provide a full scope of oral and maxillofacial surgery services for Santa Monica patients at every stage of life. From routine extractions to complex reconstructive procedures, our surgical team has the training and technology to deliver the care you need without multiple referrals.

Tooth Extractions

Safe removal of impacted, infected, or problematic teeth with sedation available.

Permanent tooth replacement that restores function and appearance for a lifetime.

Rebuilding jawbone density to support implants or address loss from extraction or trauma.

Comprehensive surgical planning for patients with extensive tooth loss or structural damage.

Advanced in-house imaging that guides precise surgical planning without outside referrals.

IV Sedation & Anesthesia

Fully monitored sedation administered in-office by our board-certified surgeons.

Orthognathic Surgery

Corrective jaw surgery to address bite alignment and structural jaw concerns.

Oral Pathology & Biopsies

Evaluation and diagnosis of unusual growths, lesions, or tissue abnormalities.

Surgical exposure and guidance of teeth that fail to erupt into proper position.

Facial Trauma & Fractures

Surgical care for injuries to the jaw, cheekbones, and surrounding facial structures.


## What to Expect on Your First Visit


Our goal is to make your first appointment as clear and comfortable as possible. Most Santa Monica patients complete their initial consultation in a single visit, leaving with a full understanding of their diagnosis, options, and next steps.

Arrival & Intake

Check in and complete your intake. Save time by finishing patient registration online before your appointment.

In-House Imaging

Your surgeon evaluates your anatomy using our on-site Cone Beam 3D imaging — completed the same day, no outside referral required.

Surgical Consultation

Your surgeon walks through your diagnosis, reviews sedation options, answers all questions, and outlines a clear treatment path.

Your Treatment Plan

You leave with a personalized plan, cost transparency, and confidence in who is performing your care.


## Why Santa Monica Residents Choose Wilshire


Santa Monica has no shortage of dental providers along its own stretch of Wilshire Boulevard. Patients who make the short drive east to our Los Angeles office do so because of what is difficult to find in a single practice — dual board-certified surgeons, in-house advanced imaging, full sedation scope, and a comprehensive range of procedures under one roof.

Two Board-Certified Surgeons

Dr. Shadi and Dr. Vahedi are both credentialed by the American Board of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons — one of the most rigorous certification processes in dentistry.

On-Site Cone Beam 3D Imaging

Our in-house 3D imaging means no external imaging centers, no extra appointments, and faster treatment planning for Santa Monica patients.

IV Sedation Administered In-Office

Our surgeons perform IV sedation and general anesthesia directly, with full monitoring — appropriate for anxious patients and complex cases alike.

Easy Access from Santa Monica

Our office at 12300 Wilshire Blvd #326 is a direct drive east from Santa Monica — accessible via Wilshire Blvd, Lincoln Blvd, or the 10 Freeway.

Full Surgical Scope in One Practice

From a single extraction to full mouth reconstruction and corrective jaw surgery — Santa Monica patients do not need multiple referrals.


## Understanding the Cost of Oral Surgery in Santa Monica


Ready to schedule your consultation?

Dr. Shadi and Dr. Vahedi serve Santa Monica patients from our office at 12300 Wilshire Blvd #326, Los Angeles, CA 90025 — minutes from the Westside.

Request an Appointment or call (310) 846-8978

The cost of oral surgery depends on the procedure, its complexity, and whether sedation is part of the plan. We believe financial considerations should never prevent someone from getting necessary care, which is why we provide a clear cost breakdown before any treatment begins. Our team reviews your insurance coverage in advance and ensures you have a full picture of expected out-of-pocket costs before your procedure.

For patients without dental insurance or whose plans provide limited coverage, we offer flexible payment options that allow costs to be spread over time. You can review our insurance and financing information before your appointment. We accept a wide range of PPO dental insurance plans and are available to answer coverage questions during your initial consultation.


## Frequently Asked Questions From Santa Monica Patients


How far is Wilshire Oral Surgery from Santa Monica?

Our office is located at 12300 Wilshire Blvd #326, Los Angeles, CA 90025. From central Santa Monica, the drive east along Wilshire Boulevard typically takes 10 to 15 minutes depending on traffic. Patients can also reach us via Lincoln Boulevard heading east or via the 10 Freeway to Centinela or Bundy.

Do I need a referral to see an oral surgeon?

No referral is required to schedule a consultation at Wilshire Oral Surgery and Implant Center. Many Santa Monica patients contact us directly after identifying a problem or receiving a recommendation from their general dentist. If your dentist has taken recent X-rays or provided records, bringing those to your appointment can help us plan more efficiently.

What sedation options are available for oral surgery?

We offer local anesthesia, IV sedation, and general anesthesia, all administered in-office by our surgeons. IV sedation and general anesthesia are appropriate for patients with dental anxiety, those undergoing multiple procedures in one visit, or complex cases requiring deeper anesthesia. Our team will discuss which option is safest and most appropriate for your specific procedure during your consultation.

How long does wisdom tooth removal recovery take?

Most patients recover from wisdom tooth removal within five to seven days, with the most noticeable swelling and discomfort occurring in the first two to three days. Patients who receive IV sedation will need a driver and should plan to rest the remainder of the day. We provide complete post-operative instructions and are available to answer recovery questions.

Does insurance cover dental implants or bone grafting?

Coverage varies by plan. Some PPO dental plans provide partial coverage for implant placement, particularly when tooth loss is the result of injury or a covered extraction. Bone grafting may be covered under medical insurance when it is linked to trauma or a medically necessary procedure. We review your specific plan before your appointment and provide a clear breakdown of covered versus out-of-pocket costs. See our insurance and financing page for more detail.

What makes an oral surgeon different from a general dentist for implants?

Oral and maxillofacial surgeons complete four to six years of accredited hospital surgical residency training after dental school, covering advanced anesthesia, complex implant cases, bone reconstruction, jaw surgery, and facial trauma. This depth of training is particularly important for patients with bone loss, anatomical challenges, or cases requiring sedation. General dentists can place implants in straightforward cases, but patients with more complex needs are typically best served by a board-certified oral surgeon.


## We Serve Santa Monica and the Westside of LA


Wilshire Oral Surgery and Implant Center serves Santa Monica residents from our office at 12300 Wilshire Blvd #326, Los Angeles, CA 90025 — a short drive east along Wilshire Boulevard. Dr. Shadi and Dr. Vahedi bring board-certified surgical credentials, advanced in-house imaging technology, and full sedation capabilities to every patient consultation. Whether you are coming in for a straightforward wisdom tooth extraction or exploring implants and jaw surgery, our team will walk you through every option and build a treatment plan tailored to your anatomy, schedule, and budget.

To get started, request an appointment online or call us at (310) 846-8978. We look forward to helping Santa Monica patients get the care they need. We also serve patients from Brentwood and Westwood, and you can view all the communities we serve across the Westside.


## Oral Surgery Services near Santa Monica


We offer specialized oral surgery services for Santa Monica patients. The pages below cover each procedure with detail for the health-conscious, schedule-driven professionals and students who make up much of the Santa Monica patient base.

Dental Implants near Santa Monica, CA — Permanent tooth replacement by board-certified surgeons, 10–15 minutes east on Wilshire with in-house 3D imaging.

Wisdom Teeth Removal near Santa Monica, CA — Expert wisdom tooth extraction for Santa Monica College students, professionals, and families.

Sedation Dentistry near Santa Monica, CA — In-office IV sedation administered by board-certified surgeons. No hospital fees or separate anesthesiologist scheduling.
